name: HIGH PINE CUSTOM APPAREL
old_description: Our manual screen printing process combines skilled craftsmanship with lasting quality. Ink is pressed through a fine mesh screen onto each garment, with a separate screen used for every color in the design. We use durable inks and meticulously maintained screens to produce sharp, detailed artwork. Whether it’s a small batch or a large run, every order receives the same care and attention to detail.
about:
High Pine Custom Apparel operates from a facility at 320 Ossipee Trail West in Standish, Maine. The company provides custom screen printing, embroidery, transfer printing, and graphic design services to businesses, brands, and musical acts.

The shop runs a manual screen printing process that uses a separate mesh screen for each color in a design, applying durable inks for sharp, detailed artwork. Embroidery work is digitized in-house and stitched with quality thread, with options for 3D puff and appliqué. Transfer printing uses heat and pressure to apply full-color designs, suited for high-color artwork, small runs, or budget-friendly projects. The team also offers in-house graphic design ranging from logo creation to full brand identity builds, and produces stickers and other branded goods. Orders range from small batches to large runs, with each receiving the same level of attention.

Customers include businesses seeking branded apparel, musical acts such as Muscadine Bloodline's Charlie Muncaster who wore High Pine gear on tour, and organizations needing promotional items or workwear. The company serves clients looking for custom hoodies, hats, and other garments, as well as those needing brand development support.

High Pine emphasizes skilled craftsmanship and consistent quality across its processes. Its manual screen printing and in-house digitizing allow control over detail and durability, while transfer printing adds flexibility for complex, multi-color designs. The combination of production and design services under one roof is intended to streamline the path from concept to finished product.
